description: This file 'Forms.php' contains a utility function 'get_chooser_js' that generates and returns a JavaScript snippet used for handling display tabs in a form within the SuiteCRM application. It appears to be part of the admin module, providing client-side logic for user interface interactions related to form chooser mechanisms.

methods.name: get_chooser_js
methods.description: Returns a JavaScript code snippet that sets up a function 'set_chooser' for collecting selected display tab options and assigning them to a form field. The function is embedded within HTML script tags.
